title: REQ · App game screen mounts PhaserHost with BootScene instead of the flat image
summary: The playing view's scene slot renders PhaserHost with BootScene and no SceneView.
description: Context: game/frontend/src/App.tsx renders <SceneView .../> (flat image plus hotspot buttons) in the GameLayout scene prop. Desired behavior: render <PhaserHost scenes={[BootScene]} /> in a full-size container in that slot, keeping ActionMenu, the Suggest button and ContributionSheet. Expected result: one canvas host is created when the playing view mounts and destroyed on unmount. Why: Phaser must own scene rendering.
acceptance_criteria: Given Begin is clicked, when App renders, then the element with data-testid phaser-host exists and no img named after the scene title exists.
Given Begin is clicked, when App renders, then createGame is called once with a scenes array containing BootScene.
Given the playing view is unmounted, when cleanup runs, then the mocked game's destroy is called once with true.

preserve: ActionMenu, Suggest What Happens Next button and ContributionSheet rendering

technical_constraints: PhaserHost is mounted only after Begin so the intro screen creates no game
definition_of_done: SceneView is no longer rendered by App
